title: Mondays versus Fridays
statementMd:
Average closing change (close minus open) on Mondays and on Fridays, rounded to 3 decimals. Two rows labelled `Monday` and `Friday`.

Expected columns: `weekday`, `avg_change`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `strftime('%w')` is 1 for Monday and 5 for Friday.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE strftime('%w', trade_date) WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' ELSE 'Friday' END AS weekday, ROUND(AVG(close - open), 3) AS avg_change FROM prices WHERE strftime('%w', trade_date) IN ('1', '5') GROUP BY weekday;
```
